correctness.rationale: Exact derivation normal form follows from [V,V]=W and centrality. D²=0 reduces to A²=rho(A)²=0 and BA+rho(A)B=0. When A²=0, rho(A)²=2 exterior²A, permitting only quotient ranks 0,1 in odd characteristic and all square-zero A in characteristic two. A Jordan-pair basis gives rank rho(A)=r(n-r-1); choosing B(y_i) arbitrarily and B(z_j) in ker rho(A) gives E_{n,r} free parameters. The flag count for square-zero A of rank r is M_{n,r}(q). The smooth-orbit/constant-rank vector-bundle proof establishes geometric statements. The embedded checker independently validates full small cases, all rank fibers in seven configurations, and modular rank-two existence/obstruction; these are not extrapolated to the theorem.
